evidence_model.formula: literature_score = design_weight x study_factor x consistency x population_match, where design_weight and population_match come from the public literature HARM claim with the highest design_weight x population_match (all claims if none shows harm, so a strong null study never inflates the harm meter); study_factor = min(1, log2(1+n)/log2(1+5)) with n = distinct public literature sources; consistency = share of directional public literature claims in the majority direction (harm vs null), 0.5 if none. Meter: Strong >= 0.45, Some >= 0.2, else Early signs. Only layer=literature claims with badge != '?' count. System graph pathways and FAERS are reported in their own fields and are never multiplied in.
evidence_model.flag_change_rules: FLAG ('Check on this person') = association strength, causal or not: max over public literature harm claims of design_weight x population_match x severity (1.0 High, 0.75 Moderate) + 0.15 if FAERS specific-composite signal clears the negative-control band + 0.10 if any FDA label carries a heat warning + 0.10 if >= 6 of 8 jurisdictions mention it. High >= 0.6, Moderate >= 0.3. CHANGE ('Rethink the medicine') = literature_score x causal_factor + 0.10 if a cited lower-heat-risk alternative exists. causal_factor = 1.0 when the drug's own mechanism is shown in humans, 0.5 when within-person or adjusted studies show no added drug effect (confounding by indication), 0.75 otherwise; for storage/absorption drugs CHANGE concerns handling, not the molecule. High >= 0.45, Moderate >= 0.2; CHANGE is capped at Moderate when causal_factor <= 0.5. Strong within-person studies showing no added drug effect -> high FLAG, lower CHANGE (spec §9).
